title: Finite open filtration for constructible finite local models
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is Noetherian (every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes). Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $B_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ on every small pro-étale site [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $F$ be a constructible $B_X$-module sheaf in the sense of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Thus $F$ has a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which the restrictions have finite constant local models: pro-étale locally they are $B_T\otimes_{\underline{\Lambda(*)}}\underline P$ with $P$ a finitely presented $\Lambda(*)$-module. There are a nonnegative integer $r$, a chain of open subschemes
$$\varnothing=V_0\subset V_1\subset\cdots\subset V_r=X,$$
and reduced closed subschemes [def-pc-reduced-scheme] $t_k:S_k\hookrightarrow V_k$ with underlying sets $V_k\setminus V_{k-1}$, such that each $L_k=(t_k)^*(F|_{V_k})$ has a finite constant local model. If $v_k:V_k\hookrightarrow X$ denotes the open immersion and $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F$ denotes its counit image in $F$ [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek, def-sfb-module-upper-star], then these counits are monomorphisms and
$$0=F_0\subset F_1\subset\cdots\subset F_r=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong v_{k!}(t_k)_*L_k.$$
The quotient isomorphisms are natural in $F$ for a fixed such stratification; $(t_k)_*$ is ordinary closed direct image [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. All the open immersions $v_k$, and the open complements of the $t_k$, are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. All sites use the fixed small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. No local Noetherianity of the structure sheaf, finite type over a field, or local freeness of $L_k$ is required; integral torsion local models are allowed.

proof.text: Use the existing proved Topology.Stratification.exists_chain_opens from WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.Devissage on the finite stratification supplied by constructibility. Its Noetherian induction gives increasing opens from empty to X with each difference inside one original stratum, so no good-refinement theorem or linear extension is needed.

Give each difference its reduced induced closed subscheme. A reduced source whose range lies in an immersion factors through its coborder open and then its closed immersion. Pull back the original finite constant model along this factorization; upperStarComp identifies the restriction. Every open scheme is Noetherian; compactness of all its subsets proves quasi-compactness, and open immersions are quasi-separated.

Use the proved mono_condensed_counit, iso_condensed_counit and module_zero_of_empty helpers of ContinuousConstructibleIntegralGluing for monicity and the two endpoints. Apply the local successor-quotient theorem to each adjacent pair. Compatibility with counits and monicity of the earlier counit imply monicity of the successor map. Choose the finitely indexed natural maps and assemble the conjunctions.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteModelStratumFiltration (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) (hF : IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X F) : ∃ (r : ℕ) (V : Fin (r + 1) → X.Opens), Monotone V ∧ V 0 = ⊥ ∧ V (Fin.last r) = ⊤ ∧ ∃ (S : Fin r → Scheme.{u}) (t : ∀ k : Fin r, S k ⟶ (V k.succ).toScheme), (∀ k : Fin r, IsClosedImmersion (t k) ∧ IsReduced (S k) ∧ Set.range (t k) = {x | (V k.succ).ι x ∉ V k.castSucc}) ∧ (∀ k : Fin r, HasFiniteConstantLocalModel Λ (S k) ((upperStar Λ (t k)).obj ((upperStar Λ (V k.succ).ι).obj F))) ∧ (∀ k : Fin (r + 1), QuasiCompact (V k).ι ∧ QuasiSeparated (V k).ι) ∧ (∀ k : Fin r, QuasiCompact ((V k.succ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V k.castSucc).ι ∧ QuasiSeparated ((V k.succ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V k.castSucc).ι) ∧ (∀ k : Fin (r + 1), Mono ((openFiltrationCounit Λ (V k)).app F)) ∧ IsZero ((openFiltrationPiece Λ (V 0)).obj F) ∧ IsIso ((openFiltrationCounit Λ (V (Fin.last r))).app F) ∧ ∃ d : ∀ k : Fin r, openFiltrationPiece Λ (V k.castSucc) ⟶ openFiltrationPiece Λ (V k.succ), (∀ k : Fin r, d k ≫ openFiltrationCounit Λ (V k.succ) = openFiltrationCounit Λ (V k.castSucc)) ∧ (∀ k : Fin r, Mono ((d k).app F)) ∧ (∀ k : Fin r, Nonempty (cokernel (d k) ≅ openFiltrationStratum Λ (V k.succ) (t k)))
